issues.description: The template's Farm.singFarmSongVerse method is declared without a parameter, but the problem statement UML and the solution expect singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal). This mismatch can confuse students when they try to implement singFarmSong() to call singFarmSongVerse(animal) or when they follow the UML/specification which requires an Animal parameter for the verse method.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the template Farm.singFarmSongVerse signature to accept an Animal parameter (private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)) and update its body to use that parameter. Ensure singFarmSong() in the template is implemented to iterate animals and call singFarmSongVerse(animal). This aligns the template with the UML and the solution while keeping the intended exercise.
